_header: Daily hard caps (USD) on paid LLM calls, per caller group (Chad 11-04). Read by api/lib/spend-caps.js. DAY BOUNDARY = the UTC day, the same one the ai_usage daily rollup uses (ai-usage-repo rollupSpend: date('now') / toISOString). A caller maps to the FIRST rule it matches (exact or prefix), else `default`. Each cap entry applies from its `from` date (UTC) until a later entry replaces it. Env override: SPEND_CAP_<GROUP>_USD (e.g. SPEND_CAP_MEDIA_USD=60). Callers in `exempt` are counted but never refused (user search must not stop). Anthropic batch calls count at their half-price rate, when the batch result is logged.

media._note: Chad 11-07: "I meant to pause the media work, not the Anis/index improvements" — media LLM paused; queues wait, nothing fails

monthly._note: Groups bounded by a MONTHLY ceiling instead of a daily cap (Chad 11-09: HyPE program at most $1000/month for everything HyPE). Daily pace = usd / pace_days; env overrides usd. Group has no entry in caps, so no daily dollar cap applies.

_provider_exempt: Groups whose spend does NOT count toward the provider-wide caps and which those caps never refuse (their own monthly ceiling governs), so readers and other background work keep the full anthropic allowance. Rules for these groups must use `exact` callers only.
_improve: Improvement cycle (Opus 5.5 judge on every search trace + reply, deep analysis on weak ones; Chad 11-04). Chad 11-04: 'a forensics budget which we will start large but reduce over time. For now it should cover everything.' $200/day covers the measured projection ($75-170/day: $0.0098/judged reply, $0.031/deep analysis); lower it by adding a later dated entry (long-run target $5/day). Over the cap the improve worker DELAYS work (weak replies first, then new searches, then backfill), never drops it. 11-06 (Chad): $5/day; the 11-04..11-06 run spent ~$312 for 14 fixes with no before/after. Searches are never capped (search-query exempt). Media $20/day (Chad 11-06). 11-06 (Chad): "Improvement budget should apply to testing and analysis, not real users" — real readers' Anís turns are counted, never refused (ai-context organic); test turns (battery*@siftersearch.com / test:true, billTo improve-anis-test), battery-judge and exchange-audit bill to improve. 11-09 (Chad, alpha demo): improve $25 for 11-09 only (tree promotion replays), Anthropic total $40/bg $35 that day so the provider cap does not undercut it; both back to $5 / $20-$15 on 11-10.

providers._note: Provider-wide daily caps (Chad 11-06: "cap anthropic costs to $20/day. when it hits that budget, queue up the work"). Every group's calls to the provider count toward `usd`. Background groups stop at `background_usd`, so the rest is kept for live Anís replies (groups in `interactive`); `usd` stops everything. Env override: SPEND_CAP_<PROVIDER>_TOTAL_USD.
